name: Tuscaloosa County, AL
findings: Tuscaloosa County has 599 nonprofit organizations. 195 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 161 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tuscaloosa County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Tuscaloosa County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 113 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
